components.name: Paper Panel
components.description: Camp price tags, pause/summary panels and toasts: leather rim, parchment face, soft offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 20px; background: #f4e4c1; border: 4px solid #8a5a34; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 4px 6px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.25); color: #4a3222; transition: transform .15s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); } .ds-panel:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-panel-icon { font-size: 28px; } .ds-num { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 20px; color: #4a3222; }

components.name: Paper Panel (can afford)
components.description: The same panel with the Go Green glow and an A prompt when the player can buy or use it.
components.css: .ds-panel-go { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 20px; background: #f4e4c1; border: 4px solid #8a5a34; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(76,194,74,0.5), 4px 6px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.25); color: #4a3222; } .ds-panel-icon { font-size: 28px; } .ds-num { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 20px; } .ds-a { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #4cc24a; color: #fff; border: 3px solid #1f4a1f; border-bottom-width: 6px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: A-Button Prompt
components.description: Floats and bobs over anything usable; nothing is used until A is pressed.
components.css: @keyframes ds-bob { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-4px); } } .ds-abtn { width: 44px; height: 44px; background: #4cc24a; color: #fff; border: 4px solid #1f4a1f; border-bottom: 10px solid #2f8f34; outline: none; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; animation: ds-bob 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-abtn:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-abtn:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #f5c629; } .ds-abtn:active { border-bottom-width: 4px; transform: translateY(6px); animation: none; }

components.name: HUD Card
components.description: Small edge-hugging counter: icon plus a ×2 numeral on parchment.
components.css: .ds-hud { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; background: #f4e4c1; border: 2px solid #8a5a34; border-radius: 6px; color: #4a3222; } .ds-hud-gem { width: 14px; height: 14px; background: #d0463a; border: 2px solid #2a1d2e; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-num { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 16px; }

components.name: Not-Yet Price
components.description: A price you cannot pay yet: the numeral turns Not-Yet Red and the A prompt fades to 35%.
components.css: .ds-price { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #f4e4c1; border: 4px solid #8a5a34; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 4px 6px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .ds-num { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 18px; color: #4a3222; } .ds-short { color: #d0463a; } .ds-a { width: 26px; height: 26px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #4cc24a; color: #fff; border: 3px solid #1f4a1f; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; } .ds-faded { opacity: .35; }

components.name: Sticker Slot
components.description: A gold frame on the book page; empty shows a faint silhouette, filled shows the sticker.
components.css: .ds-slots { display: flex; gap: 16px; padding: 20px; background: #f8ecd0; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-slot { width: 96px; height: 96px; background: #f5c629; border-radius: 14px; padding: 6px; box-sizing: border-box; box-shadow: 4px 6px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.12); transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); } .ds-slot span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #fffaf0; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 44px; } .ds-slot:hover { transform: scale(1.06) rotate(-2deg); } .ds-empty span { filter: grayscale(1) brightness(1.6); opacity: .35; }

components.name: Sticker Book
components.description: Leather cover with two pages and lifting tabs; the treasured object of the game.
components.css: .ds-book { position: relative; width: 320px; padding: 22px 14px 14px; margin-top: 16px; background: #7a3f2c; border: 4px solid #5a2a1c; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 12px 12px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-pages { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-pages div { flex: 1; height: 150px; border-radius: 8px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(#f8ecd0 0 18px, #e8d8b0 18px 20px); } .ds-tabs { position: absolute; top: -14px; left: 24px; display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: flex-end; } .ds-tabs i { width: 36px; height: 22px; background: #d8c49a; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; } .ds-tabs i.on { background: #f8ecd0; height: 30px; }

components.name: Block Bar
components.description: Build Yard tray: the chosen block big in the middle, neighbours either side, LB/RB to flip.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 72px; padding: 0 16px; background: rgba(244,228,193,0.92); border: 4px solid #8a5a34; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-bar i { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 2px solid #2a1d2e; opacity: .7; } .ds-bar i.on { width: 48px; height: 48px; opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #f5c629; } .ds-bar b { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; color: #4a3222; }

narrative.overview:
Block Diggers is a storybook you can play. Everything a player touches, from menus to the sticker book to the price tags at camp, is made of warm parchment with a saddle-leather rim, like a well-loved picture book held open on the sofa. Arcade energy happens *on top of* that paper: big icons, chunky numbers, marquee bulbs, confetti, a green A button that says "press me". The storybook sets the warmth; the arcade supplies the punch.

The world is drawn at 480×270 in hard-edged pixel art and scaled up to fill a living-room TV. Every sprite wears the same plum-black outline, so creatures, blocks and UI all feel like they came out of one hand-drawn box. The mood is cosy and warm, silly and playful, bright and colourful, and full of wonder and discovery. Mines are allowed to be deep and dark, because the lantern glow and the colours of the finds carry the warmth.

The system is built for a pre-reader. Information travels by icon, colour, number, motion and sound. Words exist only in grown-up corners (the backup panel). Screens stay sparse: one clear thing to look at, readable from across a room.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment and leather panels with a soft drop shadow; never glossy, never glassy.
One plum-black outline (#2a1d2e) around everything drawn.
Numbers-only bitmap type, always at least ×2 on screen.
Green means "go / press / you can", gold means "treasure / reward", red numbers mean "not yet".
Arcade flourish (bulbs, confetti, marquee yellow) lives inside the bonus rooms and reward moments, not in everyday UI.
Chunky, low-detail pixel art at 16px per tile.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each accent means one thing: green is "press / can", gold is "reward", red is "not yet". Don't use green for decoration or red for danger.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Rule
rules.body: Outlines are Plum Night, ink is Cocoa Ink, and shadows are black at 12–35% opacity. Solid #000 never appears as a colour.

rules.name: The Gentle Sky Rule
rules.body: Camp skies move through four soft gradients (morning, day, sunset, night) with no harsh neon. Night is deep blue-violet (#141a3a → #3a3a6e), never black.

rules.name: The Picture-Book Rule
rules.body: No words the child must read. If meaning needs a word, use an icon, a colour, a number, a motion or a sound instead. Text is allowed only in grown-up-only surfaces (the backup panel, which uses DOM text).

rules.name: The Two-Times Rule
rules.body: Numbers the child needs are drawn at ×2 or larger, so they stay readable on a TV across a room.

rules.name: The Paper Sits Down Rule
rules.body: A shadow always falls down and to the right, as if lit from the top-left lantern. It is never a glow, never centred, and never coloured (except green's "you can" glow).

dos: Do build every panel as shadow → Saddle Leather rim (2px) → Parchment face, in the radius steps above.
Do outline every new sprite or tile in Plum Night (#2a1d2e) at 1px, drawn at 16px per tile.
Do carry meaning with icon + colour + number + sound, so a pre-reader never needs a word.
Do draw any number the child needs at ×2 or larger.
Do use Go Green only for "press A / you can", Treasure Gold for rewards, and red numbers for "not yet".
Do save arcade flourishes (bulbs, Marquee Yellow, confetti) for bonus rooms and reward moments.
Do make new things pop in with a Back easeOut bounce and a happy sound.
donts: Don't add text menus, word labels or instructions to anything the child uses.
Don't go realistic or detailed: no gradients on sprites, no textures finer than the pixel grid, no anti-aliasing.
Don't use harsh neon, strobing or rapid full-screen flashing, even in the arcade rooms.
Don't use pure black (#000000) as a colour, or blurred and glowing drop shadows on paper.
Don't use red as danger or failure. Nothing in the game punishes; red only means "not enough yet".
Don't make anything start by walking into it. Show the A prompt and wait for the press.
